title: Style, voice, and terminology consistency pass
description: Audits a document set against editorial standards and produces approved consistent revisions.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: style-voice-terminology-consistency
  title: Style, voice, and terminology consistency pass
  description: Audits a document set against editorial standards and produces approved consistent revisions.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Ensure document-set consistency without changing intended meaning.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - editorial-signoff
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Document set and style guide
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - documents
          - styleGuide
          - terminology
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: audit
      kind: agent
      name: Audit consistency
      role: Editorial auditor
      prompt: Identify style, tone, terminology, capitalization, formatting, and voice inconsistencies. Cite every affected
        location.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: revise
      kind: agent
      name: Apply controlled edits
      role: Copyeditor
      prompt: Apply approved consistency edits while preserving factual meaning and document-specific intent. Return tracked
        changes.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
        tools:
          - read
          - write
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: verify
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Verify editorial consistency
      role: Senior editor
      prompt: Return passed only when remaining deviations are accepted exceptions.
      config:
        threshold: 0.95
    - id: revision-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded revision loop
      config:
        body:
          - revise
          - verify
        exitCondition: verify.passed == true
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: warn
    - id: editorial-signoff
      kind: approval
      name: Editorial owner approves final set
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Consistent documents, style exceptions, and change log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: audit
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: audit
      to: revise
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: revise
      to: verify
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: verify
      to: editorial-signoff
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: verify
      to: revision-loop
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: editorial-signoff
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: revision-loop-exit
      from: revision-loop
      to: editorial-signoff
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
    - id: revision-loop-exhausted
      from: revision-loop
      to: editorial-signoff
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
